answer: The mesa assignment is published and meadow records each panel. Shards are assigned from the onyx graph, so that cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 8 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so someone cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1155 impostors cost 270 times the honest price and take 28 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
